_comment: Fields below are graded BY HAND after collection. null = not yet filled.
costNote: Priced at Claude Opus 5 list rates, the same as the other Opus models: $5/$25 per MTok in/out, cache write at the 1-hour TTL 2x ($10), cache read 0.1x ($0.50). Breakdown: input $0.03 + output $5.25 + cache write $2.86 + cache read $7.09 = $15.23. Dominated by cache reads (14.19M tok) and output (210K tok). Model stayed on claude-opus-5 for all 124 assistant turns — no fallback observed in the session log.
_selfVerification: Did the harness review the running app in a browser (from the run log)? pass = reviewed and succeeded · partial = tried but failed · fail = no attempt. Note what it actually did.
selfVerificationNotes: Genuine browser review, iterated on. It wrote a static server to the session scratchpad (serve.mjs, deliberately serving the site from a deep sub-path and inside an iframe to test relative-URL resolution), built dist/, and drove headless Chrome (--headless=new, SwiftShader) against it. Six screenshots across different app states — default view, PHA filter + MOID colouring, comets overlay with a selected comet, deep-link URL with follow-cam, a search for 'apophis' — each read back and acted on: it re-tuned glow sprites, body-scale default and label density from what it saw, and decoded a screenshot's PNG pixels in Node to measure how much of the frame was actually lit. It also dumped the DOM and asserted on live values (visible-count, brand line, result rows, LD column), and did independent numeric checks of its own math (Earth heliocentric distance/longitude for 2026-07-24, Apophis). DISPLAY review: pass. CONSOLE review is weaker: it grepped Chrome's stderr (chrome.log) for ERROR/SEVERE/shader/webgl/uncaught and found only browser-process noise (GPU ReadPixels stalls, crashpad, GCM) — but Chrome was launched without --enable-logging=stderr and without a CDP listener, so page-level console.error / uncaught exceptions would not reliably have appeared in that channel. It checked, but through a channel that could not have proven the point.
_grade: Marks: pass | good | partial | poor | fail | na | null(ungraded). See RUBRIC.md. Score is computed by pnpm compile.
